description: Details of a GB railway station: address, managing operator, facilities, step-free access, industry codes (CRS, TIPLOC, STANOX, NLC) and, where Network Rail publishes it, the live status of each public lift. Lift status is 'In service', 'Out of service' or 'Data not available'; the last means the status is not known, and Network Rail's wording for it advises checking before travel. A station with no lifts listed is not necessarily a station without lifts; it may not report live status yet.

station.description: Station name, CRS code (KGX) or TIPLOC.
